facts.fact: The 2023 Technology Fast 50 Enterprise—Industry leaders category was open to companies that recorded a minimum revenue of $10 million in 2019.
facts.quote: This leadership category is open to companies that recorded a minimum revenue of $10 million in 2019

facts.fact: The 2023 Technology Fast 50 Enterprise—Industry leaders category required a minimum revenue of $50 million in 2022.
facts.quote: and a minimum revenue of $50 million in 2022.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's CEO said the company was an Enterprise—Industry leader for the seventh consecutive year.
facts.quote: Being an enterprise—industry leader for the seventh consecutive year demonstrates our ongoing commitment

facts.fact: The Technology Fast 50 program was celebrating its 26th anniversary in 2023.
facts.quote: Celebrating its 26th anniversary, the award recognizes Canada’s fastest-growing enterprise-level technology

facts.fact: The Technology Fast 50 program recognizes companies in four categories: Technology Fast 50 ranking, Enterprise—Industry leaders, Clean Technology, and Companies-to-Watch.
facts.quote: recognizes business growth, innovation, and entrepreneurship in four distinct categories: Technology Fast 50 ranking, Enterprise—Industry leaders, Clean Technology, and Companies-to-Watch

facts.fact: StackAdapt is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2, according to the company's own press release.
facts.quote: is rated [the number 1 demand-side platform](https://www.stackadapt.com/best-demand-side-platform-dsp) (DSP) on G2

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
